bullets.text: Samsung Galaxy Tab S11: The Best Yet - **Samsung**'s latest tablet impresses with sleek design and top-notch performance.
iOS 26 Boosts iPhone Battery - The new **Adaptive Power** feature intelligently extends battery life for iPhones.
Apple Faces £2 Billion Penalty - A UK tribunal rules against **Apple** for unfair App Store practices, potentially costing billions.
Instagram Adds Watch History - Users can now revisit previously watched **Reels**, enhancing the viewing experience.
Apple and Google Designated SMS - The **CMA** labels both companies as having strategic market status, leading to potential regulatory changes.
Waymo's Winter Challenge - **Waymo** prepares its robotaxis for winter conditions as it plans expansion into colder cities.
